mainEntity.name: Should an insurance agency prioritize AEO over traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: An insurance agency should ideally integrate AEO as a component of a broader digital marketing strategy, rather than prioritizing it exclusively over traditional SEO. While AEO offers direct answer visibility, traditional SEO builds overall domain authority, drives traffic for broader keywords, and improves site health. A balanced approach leverages traditional SEO for foundational ranking and site structure, while AEO targets specific, high-intent questions. This combination ensures comprehensive search visibility, capturing both users browsing for general information and those seeking immediate, precise answers, ultimately maximizing an agency's online reach and lead generation potential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insurance agencies should integrate AEO within a broader digital marketing strategy, not prioritize it exclusively over traditional SEO, to ensure comprehensive search visibility and maximize online reach.
